checkpoints.title: aayu mission stop, resume, and stop --end; ship refuses a stopped mission, an unlisted fix PR, and a later milestone's PR
contracts: internal/cli/mission.go: `aayu mission stop <f> [--story n] [--end] --reason`, `aayu mission resume <f> [--story n]`; plan.json `state`, `stopped[]`, `controls[]`
internal/cli/ship.go (runShip, ship.go:118): three new refusals before the merge; fix PRs from `gate_fixes` merge on proof
--end: claims released, open PRs closed, stories back to status:ready, lock.state ended with end_reason, one comment on each locked issue
instrumentation: each control writes a `controls` entry {control, by, tool, at}
the stop result lists `not reached: <task URL>`
checkpoints.rollback: Revert the squash commit. Closed PRs and the --end comments stay on GitHub: reopen a PR by hand if a revert needs it.
